field.label: Network Address
field.help: Specifies the IPv6 network address (e.g., fe80::1234) to include in OSPFv3.

field.label: Network Mask
field.help: Defines the network prefix length (e.g., 64) for the specified IPv6 address range.

field.label: Area
field.help: Select the explicitly configured OSPF area for this network.
